name: sg_suppressions_list
description: Retrieve suppressed (unsubscribed) email addresses, optionally filtered to a single unsubscribe group or email address. (GET /v3/asm/groups/{group_id}/suppressions)

group_id.description: The ID of the unsubscribe group whose suppressed addresses you want to retrieve.

email.description: Filter suppressions by a specific email address.

limit.description: Maximum number of suppressions to return. Defaults to 30.
